text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
One, two! Three, four!
Good-for-nothing, no-good five, six!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Whaddya think of my dancing?!
choice_data_list: Nice, you're so nimble out there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well, she's so dexterous she can pull off
just about anything, but still...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Guess I'm gonna charm the fans
at the Winning Live all over again..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'm not the kind of gal
who's satisfied with just this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, needs a bit more punch to it.
Zesty and sharp, just like pickled ginger!"
choice_data_list: How about adding a gag element?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oho? Sounds great!
Leave it to me and it'll be a breeze!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna pull off a gorgeous layout moonsault!
Keep your eyes wide open and feast 'em on this!
With that, Tamamo Cross dashed off...

"...Ran straight into a wall.
I couldn't help but burst out laughing."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What the heck?!
Well, as long as it got interesting, who cares!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hoh? You're really asking for that?
You want me to do comedy during the live show?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She's real shy, after all...
Wonder if she can do it...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Tonight's! Main dish! Is!
Acqua pazza!!
Tamamo Cross seemed to be having fun today, too.
